name: Intel 8085 LED Blink
desc: Intel 8085 - Blink an LED on PB.5 using OUT port instructions with a simple delay loop.
code:
; Intel 8085 - Blink LED on PB.5
; Connect an LED + resistor from PB.5 (pin 15) to GND

        MVI A, 20H       ; PB5 = 1 (output mask)
        OUT 00H           ; Configure PB as output

LOOP:   MVI A, 20H       ; PB5 HIGH - LED ON
        OUT 01H           ; Write to PB port
        CALL DELAY        ; Wait ~500ms

        MVI A, 00H       ; PB5 LOW - LED OFF
        OUT 01H           ; Write to PB port
        CALL DELAY        ; Wait ~500ms

        JMP LOOP          ; Repeat forever

; Simple delay subroutine
DELAY:  MVI D, 0FFH      ; Outer counter = 255
DL1:    MVI E, 0FFH      ; Inner counter = 255
DL2:    DCR E            ; Decrement inner
        JNZ DL2          ; Loop until E = 0
        DCR D            ; Decrement outer
        JNZ DL1          ; Loop until D = 0
        RET
